hero.headline: Re-engineering the Future of
hero.description: A revolutionary, patented turntable cleat system engineered to dramatically decrease rotational stress on the ACL/MCL — without compromising the lateral stability or explosive traction elite athletes demand.

problem.headline: Modern Cleats Maximize Traction at the Cost of the Athlete’s Knee
problem.text1: Fixed studs create high torsional resistance, making non-contact ACL/MCL tears an epidemic in soccer, football, and lacrosse. When an athlete plants and pivots, the foot stays locked in the turf while the body rotates — transferring catastrophic force to the knee.
problem.text2: Karolinias et al. (5/5/25) demonstrated that fatigue plays a significant role in ACL injuries. Current footwear offers zero adaptability to changing athlete conditions.
problem.caption: Non-contact ACL tear — the foot sticks while the body rotates, devastating the knee.

solution.headline: The Rotors Turntable System
solution.description: A precision-engineered turntable on the ball of the foot that allows natural rotation during rapid cutting — instantly releasing, rather than grabbing, the turf.

cards.title: Dynamic Biomechanical Performance
cards.description: Facilitates natural kinetic chain alignment during high-velocity pivots, actively minimizing rotational torque transferred to the knee joint during high-impact maneuvers.

cards.title: Seamless Integration
cards.description: Designed as a modular cleat plate assembly, engineered to integrate into existing performance franchises (Nike Mercurial, Adidas Predator, Puma Future) with minimal tooling disruption.

cards.title: Zero Performance Compromise
cards.description: Provides superior traction during acceleration while enabling “disengagement” protection during rotation. Athletes play with higher confidence and less fatigue.

technology.headline: Engineered Precision
technology.description: From 3D CAD to functional prototypes — the Rotors system is fully developed and patent-protected.

items.title: Full Sole Assembly — 3D CAD
items.description: Complete cleat plate with the Rotors turntable integrated at the ball of the foot. Shows the full sole architecture including fixed studs at the heel and the rotational mechanism at the forefoot.

items.title: Turntable Mechanism — 3D Model
items.description: Detailed CAD rendering of the rotor gear with cone-shaped interchangeable studs. The gear teeth interact with the torque-dampening system to control rotational resistance.

items.title: Cog Assembly — Prototype
items.description: 3D-printed functional prototype showing the rotor with cleat studs, gear teeth around the circumference, and the central screw mounting system that secures it to the sole plate.

items.image: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/Copy of FIG 2 Rotor in Sole.JPG
items.title: Patent Figure — Rotor in Sole
items.description: Technical drawing from US Patent 11,388,947 B1 showing the rotor assembly (11) with cleat members (15), gear teeth (13), and the compressible torque-dampening device (21) that controls rotation.

items.image: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/Copy of Colored rotors.jpg
items.title: Multiple Rotor Configurations
items.description: Interchangeable rotor system shown with different colors representing different torque settings and stud configurations. The cleat can be reconfigured in seconds to match field conditions and athlete needs.

items.image: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/Copy of Blue Rotor.jpg
items.title: Integrated Rotor — Cleat Profile
items.description: Side view of the Rotors cleat showing the blue turntable mounted flush in the forefoot. The “R” branding is visible on the upper. Demonstrates how the rotor integrates seamlessly into the sole without adding bulk.

items.title: Stud Retention Detail
items.description: Close-up showing how individual studs lock into the rotor gear using a push-pin retention system. This allows athletes to swap stud shapes (blade, cone, or Grabber™) without tools.

items.image: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/Copy of 微信图片_20221115083325.jpg
items.title: Manufacturing Specification
items.description: Factory sample sheet from the production partner showing material callouts (kangaroo leather upper), color specifications, insole details, and the “R” branding placement for the prototype cleat.

videos.headline: Rotors Technology Demonstrations
videos.description: Watch the turntable mechanism in motion — from controlled clicks to real-world rotation.

items.video: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/AA Copy of Coin replace.MOV
items.title: Coin Replace Demonstration
items.description: Watch the interchangeable rotor system in action — rotors swap out in seconds using a simple coin tool, allowing athletes to switch configurations between halves or before a match based on field conditions.

items.video: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/AA Copy of VIDEO Clicks.MOV
items.title: Click Mechanism
items.description: Hear the audible click feedback as the rotor engages with the torque-dampening gear teeth. Each click represents a controlled resistance point that limits rotation to a safe range.

items.video: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/AA Copy of China Rotor Click.mp4
items.title: Rotor Click — Production Sample
items.description: Factory-produced rotor from the manufacturing partner demonstrating the same precision click engagement as the prototype — confirming production-readiness of the mechanism.

items.title: Snow Pirouette
items.description: Real-world demonstration of rotational freedom on a natural surface. The rotor allows a full pirouette turn while the studs remain planted — exactly the motion that would tear an ACL in a fixed-stud cleat.

items.video: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/Copy of Bend Tabs.MOV
items.title: Bend Tabs
items.description: Demonstrates the flexible stud tab system — studs can flex under load to absorb lateral forces, adding another layer of protection beyond the rotational turntable.

items.video: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/A Copy of Video Nov 12 2025, 12 14 20 PM.mov
items.title: Rotor Assembly Demo
items.description: Full walkthrough showing how the rotor, studs, and dampening system assemble into the sole plate. Highlights the modular design that enables easy servicing and customization.

platform.headline: The First All-in-One Fully Customizable System
platform.description: Rotors is the first platform that is fully customizable to the athlete’s conditions at a specific moment. The system can be altered across three dimensions:
platform.image: Brooks Rotors GoDaddy/Copy of Colored rotors.jpg

features.title: Torque Resistance
features.description: Adjustable to match how tight the player’s ligaments and tendons are that day. Fatigued athletes get more rotational freedom.

features.title: Stud Length
features.description: Adaptable to field conditions — whether it’s freezing, raining, or a firm dry pitch.

features.title: Stud Shape
features.description: Blade, cone, or Grabber™ moveable cleat shape — configurable for sport and surface.
